integrity: Complete proof and standalone finite verifier are embedded; numerical checks supplement but do not prove the infinite-dimensional theorem. Historical-priority and independent validation limitations are disclosed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to regular crosspolytopes, axial shifts 0<h<1, and codimension-one sections. The h up-arrow 1 statement is a one-sided limit, not a formula at a vertex-passing hyperplane. Historical originality is provisional.
title: Exact face-vector mixtures and nonconcentrated near-vertex sections of cross-polytopes
